label: Bible Study
prompt: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the _____; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:
verse: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:
note: Part of Moses' blessings for obedience — leading the parade, not trailing behind it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is _____ day by day.
verse: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
note: The outward man may be wearing out, but the inward one gets renewed day by day.

label: Sunday School
prompt: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, _____ to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;
verse: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;
note: Raised as royalty, Moses refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter and stood with his own people.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But there is a spirit in man: and the _____ of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
verse: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
note: Young Elihu finally speaks: wisdom isn't just a matter of age — it's God-given understanding.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And there were four _____ men at the entering in of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?
verse: And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?
note: Four 'leprous' men at Samaria's gate asked the question that saved a starving city: 'Why sit we here until we die?'
